name: Jittor Volume Render Cuvol Wrapper
definition: A Jittor custom function wrapper that fuses the forward and backward passes of volume rendering (including background) into a single CUDA kernel launch sequence, managing memory aliases and gradient propagation for a sparse grid representation.
summary: The Jittor Volume Render Cuvol Wrapper is a custom Jittor function that fuses forward and backward volume rendering passes into a single CUDA kernel for GPU-accelerated sparse grid ray casting with automatic differentiation.
